items.title: Clinician Acceptance of Large Language Model–Generated Discharge Summaries
items.excerpt: Comparative-effectiveness study across 5 London hospitals: 12 physicians reviewed 1,294 discharge summaries; GPT-4o mini summaries from EHR data were noninferior on sign-off with no/minor edits (+22.2 points vs clinician-written) and scored higher on accuracy, completeness and clarity.

items.title: AI imaging reports comparable to the work of sonographers and cardiologists
items.excerpt: A randomized trial presented at AHA 2026 compared AI- and human-generated preliminary reports for the same 1,200 echocardiograms; blinded cardiologists edited 50.6% of AI reports vs 49.7% of human ones, meeting noninferiority.

items.title: Deep learning retinal vascular biomarker predicts preeclampsia in a multicenter prospective cohort
items.excerpt: Retina-PE, a multimodal deep learning model combining retinal photographs, maternal clinical factors and mean arterial pressure, predicted later preeclampsia in a prospective multicenter cohort, a noninvasive screening approach.

items.title: An open agentic AI co-scientist for clinical and biomedical discovery
items.excerpt: Nature Medicine paper presents OpenScientist, an open-source agentic AI co-scientist that investigates scientist-defined clinical and biomedical queries on large datasets and returns verifiable, data-grounded analyses.

items.title: Machine learning model predicts the daily risk of febrile neutropenia in patients with AML undergoing chemotherapy
items.excerpt: Using registry data from two Finnish university hospital districts, researchers trained and validated an AI model that flags early infection (febrile neutropenia) risk day by day in acute myeloid leukemia patients on chemotherapy.

items.title: Samsung Medical Center's AI tracks surgical actions, phases in video analysis
items.excerpt: SMC's CurConMix+ (IEEE TMI) recognizes individual actions, tasks and procedural phases in surgical video by combining spatial and temporal information, a step toward context-aware robotic surgical assistants.

items.title: Noul selected for $2.3 million AI diagnostics project in Panama
items.excerpt: KOICA picked Noul for a five-year, 3.1 billion won project bringing its AI point-of-care cervical cancer screening and blood testing to underserved areas of Panama.

items.title: WHO, global hospital federation to form joint committee on healthcare AI
items.excerpt: WHO and the International Hospital Federation agreed to set up a joint steering committee on healthcare AI, covering standards for AI adoption in hospitals and training for health professionals.

items.title: Is AI Really Saving Hospitals Money? A New Study Raises Questions About the Cost of AI-Driven Care
items.excerpt: A new study in the New England Journal of Medicine finds AI-generated care plans may cost far more than those ordered by physicians, challenging the assumption that clinical AI saves hospitals money.

items.title: Medicare Pays For the AI Eye Scan — Nobody Pays For What Comes Next
items.excerpt: Autonomous AI diabetic-retinopathy screening is reimbursed by Medicare, but close to half of primary-care patients who screen positive never reach an eye doctor within a year; the follow-up step has no payment.

items.title: HLTH 2026: Viz.ai, Wolters Kluwer partner on platform integration
items.excerpt: Viz.ai will integrate UpToDate clinical evidence into its Viz.ai One AI disease-detection and care-coordination platform, the first integration bringing UpToDate into AI-driven care coordination workflows.

items.title: HLTH 2026: Suki unveils agentic OS to automate complex healthcare workflows
items.excerpt: Ambient clinical intelligence vendor Suki launched Suki OS, an agentic operating system built on unified AI agents, a partner ecosystem and a performance guarantee to connect fragmented clinical software.

items.title: Patient data startup b.well launches tools to make AI chatbots safer
items.excerpt: Health data firm b.well launched 'health skills' that give AI chatbots and agents clinical guardrails for navigating patient records.

items.title: 딥노이드, AI 판독 솔루션 고도화…원격판독 시장 공략
items.excerpt: 딥노이드가 식약처 허가를 받은 생성형 AI 흉부 X-ray 예비소견서 솔루션 M4CXR을 폴스타헬스케어 원격판독 플랫폼 호크아이와 연동하고, 21세기영상의학과의원의 실사용 피드백으로 성능을 개선하는 협약을 맺었다.

items.title: 식약처, AI 활용한 백신 제조·품질관리 혁신 방안 논의
items.excerpt: 식약처가 'AI·디지털 기반 바이오의약품 품질관리 혁신과 규제조화' 워크숍에서 AI 기반 mRNA 백신 제조 변동성 제어, 백신 공정 품질관리 AI 예측모델, AI 기반 품질관리요약서 작성 등을 논의한다.

items.title: A Meta-Research Review of Statistical Practices for Image-Reliant AI Tools Predicting Lung Cancer Outcomes
items.excerpt: NEJM AI review assesses methodological rigor and transparency of image-based AI models proposed to support clinical decisions in lung cancer, cataloguing statistical shortcomings.

items.title: Deep-learning adds PCCT-like chest imaging quality to existing scanners
items.excerpt: RSNA 2026 preview: Johns Hopkins' SUMI model, trained on 1,046 photon-counting CT scans plus 405,379 conventional CT scans from 145 hospitals, brings PCCT-like image quality to routine chest CT without paired acquisitions.

items.title: CT offers opportunistic lung cancer risk assessment in heavy smokers
items.excerpt: RSNA 2026 preview: Erlangen's deep-learning model CTchest-risk, developed on 14,208 participants, predicts six-year all-cause mortality from low-dose lung screening CT, tested on NLST data against body-composition measures.

items.title: New AI approach could cut sepsis deaths and drive efficiency in emergency departments
items.excerpt: King's College London's causal explainability group built a method that explains why an AI model predicts sepsis deaths in emergency departments, pointing hospital managers to targetable causes. (Off-list: on-list ED/sepsis coverage had nothing fresh.)

items.title: AI may help spot early signs of lung cancer in the blood
items.excerpt: Cancer Research UK-backed work uses AI on blood samples taken at NHS mobile lung screening to look for early signs of lung cancer. (Off-list fallback.)

items.title: What to know about the new AI roadmap from CMS, and news from HLTH
items.excerpt: STAT Health Tech breaks down CMS' newly released clinical AI ('super intelligence') roadmap, setting Medicare's agenda for paying for and overseeing clinical AI, plus HLTH 2026 news. (STAT+ partial paywall.)

items.title: Venture capitalist John Doerr says AI company, named for his late brother, could help fix primary care
items.excerpt: Tom Health, a new AI tool for primary care backed by John Doerr, launches with the pitch that AI can relieve primary-care physicians. (STAT+.)
